questionEn: Which formulation more accurately distinguishes “disinfection” from similar ideas?
questionUz: Qaysi formulada "dezinfektsiya" shunga o'xshash g'oyalardan aniqroq farqlanadi?
choicesEn: cleaning from harmful microbes by chlorination
H₂O (two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom)
The interaction of an acid with a base to form salt and water
A complex substance that forms OH⁻ ions in solution
choicesUz: H₂O (ikki vodorod atomi va bitta kislorod atomi)
Tuz va suv hosil qilish uchun kislotaning asos bilan o'zaro ta'siri
Eritmada OH⁻ ionlarini hosil qiluvchi murakkab modda
explanationEn: Disinfection – cleaning from harmful microbes by chlorination.
explanationUz: Dezinfektsiya - xlorlash orqali zararli mikroblardan tozalash.
